Q-6882: What date is 64 days after 2022-12-17?
Answer: 2023-02-19

Calculation: Dec 17 to Dec 31 = 14 days. 64 - 14 = 50 days remaining. January has 31 days, so 50 - 31 = 19 days into February. Result: 2023-02-19.
